citations.title: Commerce SQL aggregate: Inventory allocation
citations.sql_query: SELECT inventory.category, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE inventory.stockout_flag = TRUE) AS stockout_count, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE inventory.overstock_flag = TRUE) AS overstock_count FROM commerce.inventory AS inventory WHERE inventory.snapshot_date = '2022-12-31' GROUP BY inventory.category LIMIT 100

citations.title: Commerce schema/data coverage: Inventory allocation
citations.excerpt: Yearly stockout_snapshots count inventory rows flagged stockout, not distinct stockout incidents. Latest category stockout_products and overstock_products are overlapping flag counts, not disjoint stock pools. The separate latest-snapshot overlap aggregate reports how many rows carry both flags; none of these category aggregates establishes transferable surplus or justifies shifting inventory between categories.

citations.title: Commerce SQL aggregate: Nationwide logistics
citations.sql_query: SELECT g.region, AVG(s.delivery_date - s.ship_date) AS avg_transit_days FROM commerce.shipments AS s JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON s.order_id = o.order_id JOIN commerce.geography AS g ON o.zip = g.zip GROUP BY g.region LIMIT 100
